versions.name: object limit
versions.description: Set a budget for your levels!

about:
## Object Budget
allows you to set a budget obj count for editor levels! good for like 50 OBJECTS challenge

### How To Use?
- open the editor
- pause
- click the button on bottom
- set count
- set

### Common Issues that will be fixed soon:
- preserved between **ALL** levels
- clicking object count is a bit bugged at 1st click
- idk what else, but i will fix :>
